prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions are often higher than noise-corrected results, though some recent predictions underestimated gains.
No clear effect was seen for home, wait_info changes across three tests.
Evidence for sign_in, reorder changes is still thin because the two tests contradict each other.
Evidence for sign_in, copy changes is still thin as the two tests differ in significance despite both leaning positive.
Evidence for adoption, choose_path, finish, and home notification changes remains thin with only one test per specific change type.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +7.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Grid layout story and path selection: Redesign the choose_path screen into a clear grid layout displaying path choices with prominent visual cards. (why: choose_path has high drop-off (23.8%) and long mean completion time (514s), indicating users struggle to evaluate path choices.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop pet wake up interaction flow: Replace static home intro layout with an interactive stage flow where users tap a mascot to spawn their pet onto the desktop. (why: Finish step has the lowest overall completion rate at 64.8%, and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to launch or talk to the pet.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in screen after photo upload: Move sign-in screen to occur right after photo upload customization step before adoption certificate generation. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in; placing sign-in right after pet creation ensures saved state.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop pet quick start control guide copy: Update final screen headline and body text to clearly explain tray menu controls and key shortcuts. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop pet startup animation on waiting screen: Add a pet loading animation component to the waiting screen while desktop environment initializes. (why: Home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, and 3 emails reported pets failing to show up on desktop.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path selection quick decision hint: Add a hint on choose_path reassuring users that pet options can be customized or changed anytime in settings. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing decision paralysis from users worried about permanent setup choices.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Centered layout for sign-in options: Change sign_in screen to a centered layout to focus user attention on instant login actions. (why: 2 support tickets noted sign-in stalls, and sign-in drop-off remains high at 23.1%.)
7: [adoption, layout] Compact layout for photo upload step: Switch upload_photos layout to a compact view with focused asset dropzone. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet photo creation failing or looking wrong, requiring a clearer focused layout.)
